description:
Returns selected Document Uploads for a Project.

Pass `view=ids_only` to receive an array of Document Upload ids instead of full objects.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Optional response view. Omit or pass `default` for full Document Upload objects. `ids_only` returns an array of ids and raises the `per_page` ceiling from 100 to 5000. The published `per_page` maxi...

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for the response to be translated into

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Comma-separated set of attributes to sort the list of records by.
    
Format: :primary_sort_attribute,:secondary_sort_attribute
    
Valid sort attribute options are [<field_id>, id]

latest_event_id.description: Event ID for optimistic concurrency control

integration_statuses.description: Integration statuses for ML and filename scraping services

integrations.description: Information about integration and processing statuses, references, etc.

match_criteria.description: Identifier generated based on naming standard and file format used for grouping documents into containers.

upload_completed_at.description: The date and time when the document upload was completed.

400.description:
Bad Request

Possible reason codes:
- MISSING_REQUIRED_PROPERTY
- INVALID_PROPERTY

ids.description: Array of Document Upload IDs to fetch.
